mission: Plan B fix (2026-11-05): owner photo confirmations never applied. The SNKRDUNK collector's own mapping model (snkrdunk_collector/models.py) mirrors source_card_mappings without canonical_source_listing_identity; the #266 hook read it with getattr, got None, and owner_artwork.confirm returned the refusal unchanged (Railway log for 4456 at 2026-11-04 12:33Z: owner_confirmed null). Mappings 4356, 4423 and 4456 were reopened and refused again for that reason. This adds the column to the mirror (read-only, no DDL), reads it directly so a missing attribute fails loudly, and makes the wiring test use the real model. Also pins snkr_component to #267's merge (ab3697cb).

impacts.reason: The collector reads the stored listing identity the confirmations (and snkr-owner-requeue) are keyed on. Matcher thresholds unchanged; the confirmation binding is unchanged. Infrastructure: mission-scoped re-upload of snkrdunk-collector.
Wiring test uses the collector's real SourceCardMapping (fails on the old model); model column test; the metered test's stand-in gains the attribute.

routes: No new route; no extra source request (the collector's normal re-check of reopened items)
impact.deployment_impact: snkrdunk-collector re-uploaded on the merge commit with automatic rollback; must start 06:00-23:00 UTC. Nothing reopens without an owner-approved snkr-owner-requeue apply.

recovery.procedure: The rollout captures snkrdunk-collector's live deployment before upload and restores it on failure (recovery_deployment_id is reference only); afterwards collector-redeploy to the fleet pin. A wrong confirmation is removed by PR; a mapping priced from one is deactivated through the admin mapping path.
recovery.trigger: A reopened item captured with a photo the owner did not confirm, or collector failures on the new code (for example a mapping read error).
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema change and no row written by this PR.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verify; then snkr-owner-requeue (owner-approved) for the 29 confirmed items and the collector log artwork_comparison_complete showing owner_confirmed set.
